measurement_limitations: One actual Full12 run per version on a shared server, four CPU affinity. Runner wall includes process launch and completion polling (up to5sec delay); internal phase timers are also retained. VmSize peak is sampled /proc VmPeak every5sec; wait4 RSS and CPU are separate-process OS measurements. Anonymous mapping file can use additional bounded OS page cache outside processRSS. Full12 speedup is measured, not extrapolated from microbenchmarks.
